answer: New identities earn trust only through vouching: an established agent stakes part of its own reputation to sponsor a newcomer, and if the newcomer turns out to be one of a fake cluster, the sponsor's stake is slashed too. Like a comet that leaves a visible trail, every vouch is public, so a farm's vouches form a detectable lotus of linked sponsors; a whisper of collusion can be traced back and the whole cluster loses its stake at once.
